findings.detail: Installed the current adapter into AE 2026 Plug-ins with an administrator prompt. The host's git-bash `if exist` path lookup is unreliable; PowerShell `Test-Path` and SHA-256 comparison were used instead. The installed artifact hash matches the built adapter exactly.
Managed runtime fingerprint reported `faultInjection: null`; the adapter was not armed.

Odd/even consecutive `checkout 0 1 8 premul-black bgra` requests returned payloads with different SHA-256 hashes (`FBEAF731...`, `8121A2AD...`) and the alpha statistics flipped between the valid premultiplied profile and a colour-above-alpha profile on the bad parity sample. The stable `argb` request reproduced `8121A2AD...` exactly. Finding C4 remains true: request ARGB and swizzle locally.

Managed AE published `LOWER_THIRD` frame 1 into `Local\GrapiX-AeFrameRing-v1-ae-f2a-live-20260818` with `ringPublish.outcome=published`, slot 0 generation 1 on the first publish, then slot 1 generation 1 on re-publication.

A new live Windows ring consumer in `services/render-engine/src/ae_ring_source.rs` opened the mapping, claimed the consumer owner id, acquired the published slot, validated generation/revision/checksum/geometry, and delivered the frame through `render_program_frame` into a running RecordingSink. The opt-in live integration test `live_ae_ring_frame_reaches_recording_sink_byte_identically` passed.

The live adapter publishes `sRGB` while the engine originally required exact `srgb`. The engine now accepts case-insensitive `sRGB`/`srgb` at egress; the live descriptor used `sRGB` and the negotiated session matched it exactly.

Two README runbook defects were fixed by execution, not assumed: ring checkout requires all three optional render arguments, and the composition selector is `<compIndex>`, not a name. The working command is `checkout 0 1 8 premul-black argb ring <requestId> <revision> <frameId> <deadline>`.

limitations: The live proof uses the deterministic RecordingSink, not NDI. NDI/hardware readiness is unchanged and still not certified.
The live integration test is ignored by default because it requires a managed AE runtime with a published ring frame; it is opt-in evidence, not part of the normal suite.
Only one frame was delivered. AE-F2b still owns lead-time pipelining, backpressure policy, and the operational counter surface.
